name: Boost Very High Calorie Shake (Nestle)
whyItWorks: Packs a staggering 530 calories and 22g protein into just 8 fl oz. Essential for IBD patients battling severe catabolic weight loss or early satiety who cannot tolerate large volumes of solid food.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Because of high osmolarity and calorie density, sip very slowly or dilute 50/50 with unsweetened almond or oat milk to prevent cramping.
